purpose: Source identity and authority observations for bootstrap design, not immutable execution preconditions.

review_basis.scope: User-supplied prior architectural review; source-derived findings and proposed interfaces distinguished in the review.

modern_schema_evidence: skills/todo-orchestrator/todo_orchestrator/plan.py validates and imports v3 runs/lanes and derives task/lane/run briefs
design_choices: One implementer root lane per authority, allowing edit/delegate/bind-gates without pretending to grant coordinator-only actions.
Five GH outcomes and one optional CE outcome; native context briefs are derived from plans, not duplicated as a separate todo database.
Independent co-located experiment package avoids a new authority; no core dependency on it.
mutation: No repository, database, claim, task status or source changes made while preparing this package.
revalidation: Recheck live target previews before apply. Reconcile relevant source drift; preserve unrelated dirty work. Do not blindly reapply original plans after execution has added gates or changed decisions.
